'''Nanbeige4.3-33B''' is a dense 33B model in the plain Llama architecture.<ref>[https://huggingface.co/Nanbeige/Nanbeige4.3-33B Nanbeige4.3-33B model card]</ref> The post-trained model has a thinking toggle and a <code>preserve_thinking</code> option for multi-turn tool use. The card positions it as an agentic "teacher" model and claims it beats [[qwen3-8-27b|Qwen3.8-27B]] on most agentic benchmarks. That is the developer's claim, and our baseline would check it.

== Why it is attractive here ==
* '''Plain architecture''': every RL [[frameworks|framework]] supports Llama-style models, with none of the hybrid-attention edge cases.
* '''A Base checkpoint exists''' ([https://huggingface.co/Nanbeige/Nanbeige4.3-33B-Base Nanbeige4.3-33B-Base]), useful for comparison experiments.
* '''Apache-2.0'''.

== In this project ==
Estimated 150-step run: ~6 days with [[rtx-pro-6000|PRO 6000s]] generating and [[dgx-spark|Sparks]] training, or ~2.4 days on the PRO 6000s alone. See [[run-time]].
